output.recommendation: Establish a mandatory pre-deployment validation process for AI-driven updates to critical telecom networks, utilizing an ML sandbox as defined by ITU-T Y.3172 and Y.3181 [G1][G2]. Implement a standard interface for AI-incident notifications from the pipeline (P node / MLFO) to authorities, ensuring timely response and mitigation.
output.rationale: This recommendation leverages existing standards to ensure that AI-driven updates undergo rigorous testing before deployment, as per ITU-T Y.3172 [G1] and Y.3181 [G2]. Additionally, it mandates a mechanism for real-time incident reporting, akin to the EU's approach to substantial modifications in Article 3(23) of the AI Act [G3], thereby enhancing network security and reliability.
